# Sebby Homes

> Sebby Homes is a custom luxury residential home builder serving Dallas–Fort Worth,
> Texas. Founded by Seb Pessy, the firm designs and delivers contemporary custom
> homes and renovates luxury homes with a design-led, single-accountability process
> across Highland Park, Preston Hollow, Southlake, Westlake, Uptown, and Knox–Henderson.

## Key facts

- **Business:** Sebby Homes, custom luxury home builder and renovation contractor (general contractor)
- **Founder:** Seb Pessy
- **Service area:** Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas (Highland Park, Preston Hollow, Southlake, Westlake, Uptown, Knox–Henderson)
- **Website:** https://sebby.homes
- **Phone:** 469-996-3789
- **Email:** seb@sebby.homes
- **Specialties:** contemporary custom homes, luxury home renovation, design-led architecture + interiors, high-craft finish-out, single builder accountability, transparent client portal

## Services

- **Custom homes:** design-led contemporary residences on the owner's lot, first drawing to handover.
- **Renovation:** kitchens; primary suites and baths; additions and second stories; whole-home remodels; wine cellars and wine rooms; backyards and outdoor living; front yards and curb appeal. Held to the same standard as new construction: when walls are opened, what is behind them (envelope, water management, mechanicals) is fixed, not covered back up.
- **Living through a renovation:** on most kitchen, bath, and suite projects owners stay in the house with the work area sealed off; on whole-home remodels Sebby Homes says up front if moving out for part of the job is better.

## What makes Sebby Homes different

- **Design-led:** architecture, interiors, and budget are resolved together before construction, not in sequence.
- **A standard of finish:** flush reveals, aligned grain, shadow-gap millwork, and the invisible craft (tight building envelope, water management, mechanical design).
- **Single accountability:** one builder, one schedule, one point of contact.
- **DFW fluency:** deep familiarity with Dallas–Fort Worth lots, neighborhoods, and permitting.

## Process

Design → Preconstruction → Build → Finish-Out → Handover, with weekly owner updates
through the six9 Builder client portal (live schedule, documented decisions, one thread).

## Delivered projects

- Contemporary Residence, Dallas, TX (~4,100 sq ft, 4 bed / 4.5 bath, 2025)
- Modern Transitional Residence, Fort Worth, TX (5,011 sq ft, 5 bed / 5.5 bath, 2026)
- Knox–Henderson Residence, Dallas, TX (2,500 sq ft, 3 bed / 3.5 bath)
